# Readiness and learner evidence

Generate a fast readiness checker in the caller-selected destination. It should check the expected documentation and twelve briefs, local links, screenshot, offline frontend behavior, and consistency of any clue markers or manifests. Clue markers, manifests, and flag checks support discovery and output readiness; they never establish learner competency.

Include a lightweight Vally suite with one quest-specific stimulus and expectation for each of the twelve quests. Keep Vally configuration, tooling installation, and execution in the generated destination. Suite lint checks structure; probes exercise the stated stimuli and expectations. Neither proves native HVE execution nor that a learner completed a quest. Evaluate learner evidence from the artifact or demonstrated work requested by each quest.

Report observed checks separately: readiness results, Vally lint and probes, native HVE tool execution, learner evidence, model checks, and optional connected-runtime checks. If model access or runtime prerequisites are unavailable, say so without claiming a pass. A skill/output smoke check is not learner-quest completion evidence.
